title: VQ Mirror address codebook for a bank of logical linear functions
hypothesis: For 192 logical linear functions whose weight matrices lie in a learned rank-four shared function basis, a discrete VQ address with K=16/64/128 can retain held-out function RMSE <=0.05 and at least 90% distinct held-out addresses using less actual inference bytes than continuous shared codes and far fewer bytes than independent matrices.
physical_object: four shared 16x16 linear function atoms fit from 128 training functions
mirror_coordinate: one discrete codebook index selects a latent coefficient vector decoded into a logical function matrix
logical_multiplicity: 192 callable functions; 128 fit the basis/codebook and 64 are held out
controls: independent full matrix per logical function as exact upper
native VQ codebook over shared-basis coefficients
per-coordinate int8 coefficients with paid scales

task.type: synthetic function bank; each function maps R^16 to R^16 by a linear matrix
task.vq_fit: Euclidean k-means on train coefficients only, 100 Lloyd iterations

development.selection_metric: heldout function output RMSE, unique code fraction, actual payload bytes, decode/query operation proxy and VQ fit wall time

paid_objects: all independent matrices OR all shared atoms and continuous coefficients OR all shared atoms, VQ centers and every function index OR shared atoms, int8 coefficients and scales

compute.query: Every measured function is evaluated on the same 64 random inputs. Matrix application charges D^2 MACs; shared decode charges rank*D^2 ops; VQ index decode charges K*rank distance ops during assignment and a selected latent center read at inference.

gates.PROMISING: At least one frozen K in both seeds has heldout function RMSE <=0.05, unique heldout address fraction >=0.90, actual payload <=0.25x independent matrices, and replay succeeds. Report whether VQ is a standard native codebook parameterization; no Mirror-specific claim if an ordinary VQ control aliases it.
gates.FAIL: Exact independent upper valid but VQ quality/distinct-function/storage clause fails or the native VQ implementation exactly aliases the proposed address.
gates.NOT ESTABLISHED: Independent upper cannot reproduce targets or serialization/metric replay fails.

boundaries: The bank is a deliberately rank-four synthetic family, not a neural language model or natural task set.
Function identity is a compact row ordinal and code/index table ordering is explicitly serialized.
Logical function count is not equated with capacity; held-out outputs and distinct code fraction are measured.
Fresh worlds remain sealed unless all frozen gates pass and native VQ attribution is resolved.
